cases.name: Lyneasha Justice Greenwell
cases.about:
She was a member of the Piscataway Conoy Tribe.

Margaret Proctor, Patterson’s mother and Greenwell’s grandmother, said her family had been deeply affected by the loss of their loved ones. “They’re the sweetest people in the world,” she said. “Martina would do anything for anybody. Take her shirt right off her back for anybody.”
